# The Age of the World Picture

*[Martin Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) · 1950 · *Die Zeit des Weltbildes**

A lecture of 1938, published in 1950 in Off the Beaten Track. [Heidegger](../philosophers/heidegger.md) describes modern science there as "research", which projects in advance a calculable ground plan of nature, and the modern age as the one in which the world becomes a picture represented by a subject.
